data.label: App Blueprint
data.appGoal: A simple calculator that adds, subtracts, multiplies and divides two numbers.
data.appPurpose: Users will type two numbers, pick an operation, and see the result.

data.label: Calculator Interface
data.description: Two number inputs, an operation selector, an equals button, and a result readout. Collects the two values and the chosen operation and sends them to the logic node.
data.appGoal: A simple calculator that adds, subtracts, multiplies and divides two numbers.
data.appPurpose: Users will type two numbers, pick an operation, and see the result.

data.label: Calculator Logic
data.description: Takes the two numbers and the selected operation. Validates that both are real numbers, performs the addition, subtraction, multiplication or division, and returns the result. Guards against dividing by zero.
data.appGoal: A simple calculator that adds, subtracts, multiplies and divides two numbers.
data.appPurpose: Users will type two numbers, pick an operation, and see the result.

data.label: Validation & Error Handling
data.description: Checks the inputs are valid numbers before calculating. If a value is empty, not a number, or division by zero is attempted, it returns a clear error message instead of a broken result.
data.appGoal: A simple calculator that adds, subtracts, multiplies and divides two numbers.
data.appPurpose: Users will type two numbers, pick an operation, and see the result.

data.label: Results Display
data.description: Shows the answer from the logic node, or the friendly error message. Keeps the screen readable and reveals the result clearly after the equals button is pressed.
data.appGoal: A simple calculator that adds, subtracts, multiplies and divides two numbers.
data.appPurpose: Users will type two numbers, pick an operation, and see the result.
